name: finetune
description: Wraps core/finetune_prep.py's dataset export/notebook generation, core/lora_import.py's read-only adapter inspection, and its backup/rollback (file-copy only) functions as CCOS capabilities. Deliberately does NOT expose merge_lora_with_llama_cpp, swap_to_finetuned_model, or import_lora_adapter from core/lora_import.py — those replace the live model file the daemon runs on. create_backup_before_import and rollback_to_backup were added per Ish's decision: they only copy files and don't touch the active model, and having them agent-accessible lets an agent protect current model state before a risky operation.

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_curate_examples
capabilities.description: Curate ShareGPT-format fine-tuning examples from episodic interaction history, filtered by recency and quality

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_export_dataset
capabilities.description: Export curated examples to a ShareGPT-style JSONL dataset file

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_generate_notebook
capabilities.description: Generate a ready-to-run Unsloth Colab notebook for off-device LoRA fine-tuning

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_print_instructions
capabilities.description: Print step-by-step user instructions for the Colab fine-tuning workflow

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_prepare_data
capabilities.description: High-level entry point: curate, export, and generate notebook(s) for fine-tuning in one call. Purely generative — writes dataset/notebook files, does not touch any active model.

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_validate_adapter
capabilities.description: Read-only: validate that a directory looks like a well-formed LoRA adapter (checks for adapter_config.json and weight files)

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_adapter_info
capabilities.description: Read-only: report size and LoRA config metadata (base model, rank, alpha) for an adapter directory

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_create_backup
capabilities.description: Create a file-copy backup of the current configured model (primary or secondary) before importing a LoRA adapter. Does not touch the active loaded model.

capabilities.name: coding.finetune_rollback_backup
capabilities.description: Overwrites the live, configured model file (core/lora_import.py's rollback_to_backup: shutil.copy2(backup, original_path)), then deletes the backup file itself (backup.unlink()) leaving no further fallback, then unloads and reloads the primary/secondary model via core/loader_v2.py (a real model-load cycle — see CLAUDE.md rule 2 RAM discipline). This is NOT file-copy-only: it mutates the live model file and destroys its own backup as a side effect. When called with model_variant='secondary', it calls loader.load_secondary(), a method ModelLoader does not implement (see NEW_ISSUES.md NEW-24, Confirmed, unresolved) — the call raises AttributeError AFTER the model file has already been overwritten and the backup already deleted, leaving no working model and nothing to roll back to. Description corrected 2026-07-30 — PENDING_ISH_DECISIONS.md's original 'lower risk — file-copy only, no model mutation' framing for this function does not match the code; see PENDING_ISH_DECISIONS.md correction note.
